title: WIT StrategyConfig (Class A) — wire config v1
$comment: Machine copy of the WIT-03 §3.4 StrategyConfig, corrected to match the engine (WIT-P3c-1): session is ET wall-clock (America/New_York; 09:30/11:00/15:55 — same instants as the prior CT example), matching vp_orb_runner load_5min. The mode/enum tokens are the Class-A dimensions in contract/modes.md; an out-of-vocabulary mode -> UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT. Derived deterministically from a filled WIT-02 template by the engine-side mapper (P3c-2). config_version stays 1.0 (wire shape unchanged from §3.4). WIT-P5n: every field now carries a declared type/unit/range derived from what the engine ACTUALLY requires; HONOURED fields are range/enum-enforced by wit/config_validator.py at the mapper output and the /wit/v1/runs inbound boundary; fields marked 'declared but NOT applied in v1' are baked to a constant by the runner and are typed but not value-enforced (a specified value that differs from the baked constant is DISCLOSED via a notapplied_* code in assumptions_applied, never rejected).

instrument.$comment: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the engine bakes MES economics ($5/point, tick 0.25); instrument fields are disclosed (notapplied_instrument_*), not enforced.

symbol.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 (engine bakes ES/MES); disclosed via notapplied_instrument_symbol if != 'ES'

tick_size.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 (engine bakes tick 0.25)

tick_value.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 (engine bakes $5/point)

proxy_for.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 (disclosure only)

dataset.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the engine always reads the shipped ES 5-min parquet; disclosed via notapplied_data_dataset if != 'ES_5min_continuous'

granularity_needed.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the profile resolution comes from setup_entry.params.granularity; disclosed via notapplied_data_granularity_needed if != '1min'

window.$comment: HONOURED — start_date/end_date on the run. ET calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

session.$comment: ET wall-clock, matching the engine (vp_orb_runner load_5min: tz-naive ET). trade_window = [entry_start, entry_cutoff] (HONOURED -> entry_window_start/last_bar); force_flat is baked to the last RTH bar.

tz.description: HONOURED (hard gate) — must be America/New_York; a divergent value raises UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT (C1) at the adapter, so it is documented here rather than const-enforced (which would mis-label it INVALID_CONFIG).

force_flat.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the engine force-flats at the day's last RTH bar; disclosed via notapplied_session_force_flat if != '15:55'

filters.$comment: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the runner has no regime/calendar filtering; disclosed via notapplied_filters_* if non-empty.

regime.description: declared but NOT applied in v1

calendar.description: declared but NOT applied in v1

bias.$comment: HONOURED (hard gate) — the adapter raises UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT (D1) unless mode == vp_value_area_break. Documented, not enum-enforced here, so the hard gate owns the error type.

mode.description: HONOURED (hard gate D1): must be vp_value_area_break (allowed template tokens: vp_value_area_break | orb_break | none); a divergent value -> UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT at the adapter.

trigger.description: HONOURED (hard gate D3) -> entry_mode: must be bar_close_beyond_level (close) or bar_body_beyond_level (body); any other value -> UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT at the adapter.

level.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the runner uses VAH/VAL structurally by direction; disclosed via notapplied_setup_entry_level if != 'va_high_low'

order.description: HONOURED (hard gate D4): must be market_on_close (allowed template tokens: market_on_close | market_next_open); a divergent value -> UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT at the adapter.

value_area_pct.description: HONOURED. A FRACTION of opening-window volume, NOT a percent: 0.70 means seventy percent. The engine computes the value area as value_area_pct * total_volume (wit/volume_profile.py). A value in (1,100] is normalized by /100 at the boundary and disclosed as D2_value_area_normalized; values <=0, >100, null or non-numeric are rejected (INVALID_CONFIG).

granularity.description: HONOURED -> vp_granularity: must be '5min' or '1min'; any other value -> UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT at the runner (WIT-P4l).

sizing.$comment: HONOURED (hard gate E1) — the adapter requires fixed_contracts / value == 1; documented, not enforced here, so the hard gate owns the error type.

mode.description: HONOURED (hard gate E1): must be fixed_contracts; else UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT at the adapter.

value.description: HONOURED (hard gate E1): must be 1 (one MES); else UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT at the adapter.

mode.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the runner bakes level_offset (POC +/- ticks); disclosed via notapplied_exits_stop_mode if != 'level_offset'

ref.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the runner always uses the point of control; disclosed via notapplied_exits_stop_ref if != 'poc'

ticks.$comment: HONOURED -> stop_offset_ticks. POSITIVE ONLY: the runner applies the side by direction (POC - off for longs, POC + off for shorts); a negative value would place the stop on the wrong side of the level (WIT-P5i).

mode.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the runner bakes r_multiple (entry +/- value*R); disclosed via notapplied_exits_target_mode if != 'r_multiple'

management.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 — no intratrade management; disclosed via notapplied_exits_management if non-empty.

time_exit.description: HONOURED (hard gate F4): must be force_flat (allowed template tokens: force_flat | fixed_time | none); a divergent value -> UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT at the adapter.

same_bar_policy.$comment: HONOURED -> same_bar_policy in _resolve_exit. Validator-enforced: the runner has NO gate for an unknown value (it would silently fall through to stop_first), so an out-of-set value is rejected here as INVALID_CONFIG.

risk_controls.$comment: declared but NOT applied in v1 — the runner structurally takes at most one trade/day with no re-entry.

max_trades_per_day.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 (baked to 1); disclosed via notapplied_risk_controls_max_trades_per_day if != 1

reentry.description: declared but NOT applied in v1 (baked to none); disclosed via notapplied_risk_controls_reentry if != 'none'

assumptions_applied.description: Field ids / dimensions where a WIT-02 §5 default was injected, plus WIT-P5n disclosure codes (D2_value_area_normalized; notapplied_* for a declared-but-not-applied field whose specified value differs from the baked constant); echoed into the report.
